title: Sharper circuit evaluation magnitude bound
statement: Let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ integer inputs, and let $X\ge2$ be an integer. If every input $x_i$ satisfies $|x_i|\le X$, then the absolute value of the circuit's output is at most $X^{2^{\operatorname{size}(C)}}$.
hypotheses_covered: each input has absolute value at most $X$
